title: Phir fatima pa zulm hua
body:
Phir fatima pa zulm hua waa museebata Ki dushmano'n ne aur jafa waa museebata
Aaramgaahe fatima zahra ujad gayi
Bechain hai rasoole khuda waa museebata
Naamo nishaane turbate zahra mita diya
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaqar mazaar tak na raha waa museebata
Qabro'n me so rahe the musaafir thake hue Ki zaalimo ne un pa jafa waa museebata Ki ashqiyaa ne be adabi turbato'n ke saath
Qabro me bhi na chain diya waa museebata
Marne ke baad fatima zahra pa ye sitam
<<DIVIDER>>
Turbat me bhi na chain diya waa museebata
Ab qabre sayyada ka pata bhi nahi raha
syedaaniyo'n pa hashr hua waa museebata
